title: Longform: migration retrospective
question: How should the migration retrospective be organised?

options.label: Chronological
options.description: Month by month from decision to cutover. Reads like a story and is easy to write.

options.label: By theme
options.description: Planning, data, rollout and people as separate chapters. Easier to skim, loses the sequence.

options.label: By decision
options.description: One chapter per decision, each with the alternatives rejected.

content: The retrospective runs about 4,000 words and will be read once, start to finish, by the team that did not do the work.
